researcher_notes: No roster row matches (searched Yarudey/YarGeo/Nadym in GGIT snapshot 20260930: only Nadym-Punga P2348/P4145-4148, Medvezhye-Nadym P7546/P7547, Novoportovskoye-Yamburg P2358, Kharasaveyskoye-Bovanenkovskoye P3607, none with these endpoints). Length 148 km sourced (>=25 km): sagatelecom.ru and rtelecom.ru are the same contractor case study reprinting the YarGeo profile ('148-километровый газопровод до узла сдачи газа в транспортную систему Газпрома'), so one original, not independent; operating inferred from the same text (field in commercial production since 2015, YarGeo 'operates' the pipeline). Neither page names 'KS Nadymskaya': the name and the 0-149 km chainage come only from a YarGeo construction tender title (bicotender.ru/tender18433028.html), which returned 403 (bot wall) to fetch.py and was NOT loaded, so it is not cited; it is consistent (149 chainage vs 148 stated). neftegaz.ru field page (loaded, cited nowhere for a value) confirms the field infrastructure includes a 'газопровод внешнего транспорта' (external-transport gas pipeline) and 2015 production start but gives no length. Diameter not found in any loaded source; left blank. StartYear not stated for the pipe (field commercial production 2015; search snippet said 1 Dec 2015, unverified) so StartYear1 left blank. Owner Yargeo: entity_lookup found no close entity (stage as new); Parent Novatek PJSC (entity_lookup 100) per sagatelecom 51% NOVATEK stake (page names the 49% partner as Nefte Petroleum Ltd; other sources say Fund Energia; not staged). Capacity not stated. Tier medium: single contractor-page original that does not name the pipeline. | RULING NEEDED/PROPOSED: PipelineType=transmission (field export line of 148 km from the CPS to the Gazprom handover, 'external transport' per neftegaz, not an intra-field gathering network); flip to gathering if Baird treats field export lines as gathering. Route not found. | RULING 2026-09-30 (Claude, delegated by Baird): PipelineType=gathering, consistent with the other D3 field connections (Yurkharovskoye, Samburgskoye); at 148 km it is the strongest case for transmission, so revisit if Baird prefers export lines as transmission.
